one_liner: Apify has a broad REST API with free-tier API tokens (no card), webhooks, OpenAPI spec and an official hosted MCP server; ready to build.
auth_notes: REST API uses a secret API token as Bearer header or query param. OAuth is documented only for the MCP server; no evidence of a self-serve OAuth app registration for the main REST API, so API token is primary.
access_notes: Permanent free plan with $5 monthly usage credit, no credit card; API token available from Console.
blocker_notes: Free credit is limited, but that is not a blocker.
